_comment: Decision D-NP6 as data: which AI identity capabilities the program builds on, per cloud, with the release stage and availability Learn gave on October 30, 2026. 'available' false means the agent-id reads aren't sent in that cloud and the D-NP6 fallback applies: service principals and managed identities under the same governance. A capability whose stage is preview is a watch item: the code reports it, never enforces it. Status Proposed until the CIO, with the Chief AI Officer, decides; a change to this file is a reviewed pull request. Design guidance.
